title: Counter redemption
help: Scan the signed QR on the coupon PDF or printed slip. Serve only when this screen says SERVE.
disconnected: Reconnecting — do not serve. Retry the pending request or send the person to the admin desk.

states.RECOVERED: PREVIOUS RESULT RECOVERED — DO NOT SERVE AGAIN

countHelp: Counts cover member/slot entitlements; replacement PDFs do not increase them.
lookup: Find coupon by code, member ID or name
lookupWarning: Check the person's identity and selected counter before serving.
replaceWarning: The old QR will stop working. A replacement receives a new code; a void does not.
replacementSaved: Replacement saved. The old QR is invalid.
closeWarning: I understand closing is final and all outstanding coupons will expire.
closed: Event closed. Outstanding coupons are expired.
